control.lifetime: Stop admission first; drain active work; release leases only when idle; clear heartbeat after draining.

scan.lifetime: Cancel scan timers on stop; wait for active scans; invalidate scan caches when rebinding storage.

availability.lifetime: Keep the active promise and job lease together; ignore old-generation results; clear per-account caches when context changes.

verification.lifetime: Verification timers cannot bypass admission; transfer proof and completion remain in one atomic commit; rebind stores under maintenance.

cleanup.lifetime: Stop retry timers; wait for sweep, inspection and per-directory operations; retain durable cleanup authorization on failure.

legacyCacheRecovery.lifetime: Owns the pending scan promise; start is idempotent, admission and shutdown wait for busy to settle; old-generation scans cannot write.

transferRecoveryProjection.lifetime: Owns reconciliation throttle; explicit runtime refresh only, reset after storage rebind; reads never schedule work.

accountRetirement.lifetime: Owns per-account pending operations and aborted download job identities. Duplicate retirement shares one promise; shutdown and maintenance drain busy; late cancellation cannot write across generations.

retirementTransferWorkflow.lifetime: Assembled once with narrow storage and queue ports; reuse the same workflow for retirement snapshots and completion jobs so no request loses workflow context.

sourceDeletionWorkflow.lifetime: Assembled once after queues and account retirement exist; source deletion calls reuse the same coordination boundary and never rebuild dependencies per request.

legacyImportRecoveryWorkflow.lifetime: Uses the current database adapter after a guarded rebind; capture and resume share one workflow handle and never retain a replaced connection.

recoveryAutomation.lifetime: Owns startup and interval timers and the active batch; stop invalidates pending work, drain busy before storage replacement.

maintenance.lifetime: Identity-bound leases, summaries and cleanup admission share one owner; stale releases cannot unlock a newer operation, synchronous failures release their lease, and failed rebind retains the write barrier.

quality.lifetime: Release artifact locks only after the associated operation has settled; recheck generation before replacement or cleanup.

dependencies.lifetime: Pass narrow capabilities; do not retain bare database connections across a maintenance replacement.

remoteVerificationIO.lifetime: Owns directory cache and rate reservations; reset under storage rebind; old reads cannot refill cleared cache.

localCleanup.lifetime: Owns sweep, per-video work and retry timers; stop admission and drain before reset or database rebind.

favoriteScan.lifetime: Owns scan policy and self-visible observations; admission tracks its returned work; reset invalidates observations on rebind.

localCapacity.lifetime: Owns inspection promise, snapshot, recovery summary and queued refresh. Stop queued work before shutdown; reset rejects stale observations across rebind.

accessProbes.lifetime: Probe policy uses narrow adapters; scheduling control owns the claimed job and active promise. Results must pass generation and admission checks.

remoteScan.lifetime: Remote scan policy returns counters to its parent cycle; all workers drain before completion; late observations cannot write after generation change.

recoveryWorkflow.lifetime: Owns assessment promises and shared action locks; all pending work and held locks participate in shutdown draining.

runtime.lifetime: Owns admission, generation, initialization, rebind and shutdown promises. Failed drain retains database and leases; failed rebind retains closed admission.

remoteStorage.lifetime: Configured once at composition; requests remain outside transactions and are discarded on runtime generation changes.

transferWorkflow.lifetime: Owns upload construction and durable admission policy; supplied ports resolve current storage, runtime generation guards task callbacks.

downloadAdmissionPolicy.lifetime: Combines runtime admission, maintenance, capacity and queue constraints without owning health or cooldown state.

workState.lifetime: Read-only projection of public workflow and queue state; it owns no timer, lock, promise or cache and is rebuilt with the runtime assembly.

runtimeConfig.lifetime: Applies configuration changes through queue, admission, capacity and wake ports; it owns no task or scheduling state.

statusProjection.lifetime: Read-only scheduler and queue projection assembled once from narrow state ports; it owns no request, timer, lock or cache.

startupWorkflow.lifetime: Owns the fixed startup recovery order and delegates individual recovery operations to stable workflow instances; shutdown prevents a new recovery pass.

verifiedTransferCommit.lifetime: Stateless command assembled once from transaction repositories; every verified upload group uses the same proof and cleanup authorization boundary.

backupEnqueueWorkflow.lifetime: Assembled once with current state and job ports; every sync and recovery request shares the same admission boundary.

encodingRecoveryWorkflow.lifetime: Assembled once after cleanup and transfer ports exist; recovery callbacks use the current generation and persistent job lease.
